question: What are the top 5 product categories (English names) by revenue?
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           oi.price + oi.freight_value AS revenue,
           p.product_category_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       SUM(orv.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM order_revenue orv
JOIN category_translation ct
  ON orv.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
